text:
Stop treating your feed like a diary. It's costing you.

She only looks at the first six photos. Not nine, not twenty. Six. And if those six are blurry, drunk, or just existing, she's already gone.

You're not failing at dating. You're failing at curation.

Delete the party photos that make you look like you have no standards. Delete the selfies taken from angles. Delete every photo that isn't showing who you are at your best, strongest, most put together.

Your profile isn't a scrapbook. It's a storefront.
caption:
Profile curation is discipline. Your feed is your first impression. Most men treat it like a junk drawer.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
